title: Web Chatbot vs WhatsApp Chatbot: Which Is Better for Leads?
description: Web chatbot vs WhatsApp chatbot: where each wins leads, where each falls short, and how European businesses can use both with one shared set of answers.
author: Yogansh Banthia

hero.alt: Web chatbot vs WhatsApp chatbot: a laptop and a phone showing chats

faq_heading: Questions businesses ask about web and WhatsApp chatbots

faqs.q: How much does a web or WhatsApp chatbot cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the channels, the languages, the size of your content and the systems it connects to. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: Go-live depends on the channel, the number of integrations and how quickly your team approves the answers and handover rules. WhatsApp can also need time for account access and template approval. Clara AI confirms a timeline after diagnosis.

faqs.q: Which systems can the chatbot connect to?
faqs.a: Typically your CRM, calendar and email, so leads and handovers appear where your team already works. The exact list is confirmed during diagnosis.

faqs.q: Can we start with one channel and add the other later?
faqs.a: Yes. Many businesses launch on one channel and add the second once it is working. Because both share the same answers and records, the second channel builds on the first.

faqs.q: Will customers know they are talking to a bot?
faqs.a: Yes. We design the chatbot to say it is an automated assistant, and customers can ask for a person at any time.
